note: Fixed corpus for the velocity-dealias regression harness (dev-only). Each volume is a committed .V06 under Assets/RadarCorpus/, replayed through the REAL decode/dealias path (radar-decode.js decodeAndBuild -> dealiasSweep) and scored on its over-unfold ratio (hi/total, |v|>55 m/s gates). 'expectedPct' is the established baseline over-unfold percentage; a run flags a volume 'Worse' when actual exceeds expectedPct + tolerancePct (the KTLX-3x-regression guard). To score a volume WITHOUT committing it, drop the .V06 into Assets/RadarCorpus/ (it is served the same way) and list it here by filename, then just don't 'git add' it. Baselines REFRESHED 2026-08-03: the original 2026-07-20 seeds (KBUF 31.3%, cluster 3-4%) predated the EDGE_SKIP=100 gap-skip fix (commit 33ff264, 2026-07-22) and were stale ceilings that made the guard toothless; re-measured in-app they are all ~0%, so these tight baselines now catch a real dealias regression (e.g. re-breaking EDGE_SKIP spikes KBUF-140342 back to ~31%). See docs/radar-validation.md 'KBUF 31% seed'.
